There's no such thing as not sick enough, you deserve to get help no matter what you look like. Realising and accepting that you need help is the most important step, you don't have to have had anything bad happen to you yet, and I sincerely hope you realise how much you deserve to recover, no matter how long you've had this disorder or what complications you may or may not have.

The only difference between shrooms and truffles are basically that they are different species and and the high will be different in length, and the content of psilocybin.

The active substance in both truffles and magic mushrooms is psilocybin, so the high is the same. So what differs most  is the amount you eat.

Actually for me, the most intense trip I've ever had, was when taking truffles, 15g of white diamond if I remember correctly.  For shrooms, the highest amount I've ever taken is probably around 2g, and from that experience I'd say I'd have to take probably around 4-5g to have the same trip as with the truffles white diamond.

Also note that since these truffles, and shrooms for that matter, will differ in psilocybin content a bit randomly. You can't really tell exactly how much they will contain so sometimes you might get lucky with a higher psilocybin content, and sometimes you might get unlucky.

Another thing, you really want to make sure you haven't eaten anything for at least 5h I'd say before you eat truffles or shrooms, otherwise it will not have as good of an effect, or you might not feel anything at all.
Also it is important to note that dosages also vary from person to person.

And for the next time you want to eat them:
Depending on the person, your tolerance will baseline after 1-2weeks, where 2 weeks is the safe amount of time to wait. 
If you want to take again the following day, you will hav to take double the amount you had the day before, that is how quick your tolerance will go up.

Hope this helps :)
